title: On Spherically Symmetric Sprays
summary: This paper studies spherically symmetric sprays, i.e., sprays that are invariant under orthogonal transformations. We first establish a canonical form for such sprays, showing that their geodesic coefficients can be expressed as \(G^i = |y|α(r,s) y^i + |y|^2β(r,s) x^i\), where \(r = |x|^2\) and \(s = \langle x,y\rangle/|y|\).
